finding: One ordered on-hit chain, run only when the attack lands: armour step (damage, condition, armour-type sound), difficulty, health-damage sound, blood at the hit point, then a stagger roll (agility term vs raw damage plus a 0-99 roll) that picks knockdown or hit recovery. The victim stays locked for the hit clip length. A handler returning false skips the rest. No hit stop, shake or flash in the parts read. Numbers are Morrowind GMSTs not in the box; GPL, shape only.

Skyrim SKSE plugin with no hit-feedback code in src/. The only hit vocabulary is event names in the Nemesis behaviour tables (preHitFrame, HitFrame, 2_HitFrame, recoil and stagger start and stop, blockHitStop, 61 SoundPlay names). Event-name tables give no timing; the four clip trigger arrays are placeholders at local time 0. Idea only: a named pre-hit cue on each attack, separate from damage. MIT.
